links.outcome: Fracture detection accuracy of DL models versus human raters of varying expertise on same data
links.effect: DL models showed comparable accuracy as residents in detecting moderate/severe fractures (0.988 vs. 0.991, p > 0.05); SpineQ v1.1 had comparable AUROC and higher accuracy than experts; students lowest.
links.quote: DL models showed comparable accuracy as residents in detecting moderate/severe fractures (0.988 vs. 0.991, p > 0.05) on vetebral level.

screen.reason: Retrospective reader-comparison study comparing the diagnostic accuracy of deep learning models and commercial software to human raters across various experience levels on public CT datasets.
